title: What Is a Healthy Heart Rate Variability by Age?
description: HRV drops ~1 ms/year after age 35—learn what’s healthy for your age, when low HRV signals risk (e.g., <40 ms at 45), and how to improve it naturally.
reasoning: People are suddenly searching 'beat to beat variability' because wearable apps (Oura, Whoop, Apple Watch) now surface raw HRV metrics—causing confusion and anxiety among adults 35+ who see declining numbers but lack context on age norms, clinical meaning, or actionable next steps.
perplexityQuestions: What is a normal beat-to-beat variability (HRV) for a 35-year-old adult?
Is an HRV of 40 ms dangerous for a 45-year-old with high blood pressure?
Why is my heart rate variability so low at age 50 even though I exercise daily?
What HRV score indicates I am overtraining or need rest at age 38?
Is a 20% drop in my HRV from my 30-day average a sign of illness for adults over 40?
